bound_derivation: Both original collection source pins fix ROOT_CAP90 and PRESERVATION_ROOTS8: 960*98+9*8=94152 rows; 969*8=7752 ordinary rows; six actions=46512 U upper bound. Unicode widths derive only from the frozen eligible ID list plus decimal decision <=14400. Wall120s is a pre-data finite parser runaway guard for this inventory; it is not a measured real-input forecast.
exclusions: No D4096 or t34-round0-study-01 path, symlink component, foreign life, excluded parent/fold, dynamic reference traversal or unknown schema. Source open uses no-follow directory FDs.
outputs: all U ordinary legal selectable non-exact units
source bindings and accepted review pins
exact frozen and observed life ID sets, each missing/extra classification, complete count-evidence reconciliation
raw_JSON: HOLD: original lives lack direct served selectability. No observation-derived mask, raw JSON adapter, replay or inference.
real_access_gate: Fixed-path bounded acceptance and separate renewed one-scan authorization receipts are required. v2 acceptance binds both rulings and exact source/tests/contract/inventory pins; the authorization binds same pins and the fixed fresh output. CLI reserves output create-only before extract_accepted verifies current pins and source identity. No real scan is executed during preparation. Prior never-retry authority does not transfer. The direct API also requires an empty exclusive regular-file reservation FD at the exact fixed output inode; it writes/fsyncs RESERVED before source access, preventing reuse. Output creation uses no-follow directory descriptors.

reconciliation.current_evidence: null: available frozen metadata has no per-life retained counts. Missing siblings will refuse; no diagnosis is claimed. Adding genuine proof changes inventory pins and requires independent acceptance again.
reconciliation.on_refusal: Refused.reconciliation preserves metadata ID sets, difference classifications and count contradictions. Redacted exception text contains no source identities. Gated CLI writes REFUSED metadata to the one fresh output and returns 2; no automatic retry.
reconciliation.policy: Exact frozen/observed sets and each missing/extra ID are recorded. Extra IDs and missing selected IDs always refuse. A missing ordinary-only sibling needs separately pinned metadata counts proving ordinary=doom=0; absence alone proves nothing. Count evidence must cover the entire frozen ID set, meet original caps and match every observed per-life stratum count. No aliases or fabricated rows.

proof_schema.counts: every exact frozen life_id -> {ordinary: integer 0..8, doom: integer 0..90; sibling doom=0}
proof_schema.provenance: nonempty metadata provenance independently verified by reviewer, never derived from missing IDs

serialization.arrays: C-order, bool |b1; Unicode little-endian <U; no objects, bytestrings or structured dtypes
serialization.format: np.savez compressed/stored NPZ; seventeen independent NPY members

synthetic_helper: Only OS-tempfile fixtures. Real source lies outside that tree; excluded paths and symlink ancestors fail before input open.
